content:
In an old interview, Buzz Aldrin told Conan O'Brien that we're watching an animation of the space, not real thing. They call us conspiracy theorists: today is the year 2026, and we're still watching animations of the space and rockets in space, and by now everyone should know why.

If you don't know, I'll tell you my opinion based on my research: Since the 1950s, the United States and Russia have had unconventional propulsion vehicles that can fly in deep space, and they probably used them to build many military installations in space by the mid-1960s, which is why all of this is classified so we can't see it.
